detail.longDescription: In git checkout, a 40-character hex string does not always mean a commit. Claude Code before 2.1.179 pinned plugins to a SHA but never checked HEAD after checkout, so an upstream branch named after that SHA installed instead of the reviewed commit (CVE-2026-86063, found by Or Nevo Michrowski of Air Security). If you pin by hash anywhere, assert that git rev-parse HEAD equals the pin. https:// github.com/advisories/GHSA-pq7 j-f95f-qfcv # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Git # SupplyChain
